name: Workday Adaptive Planning
description: Workday Adaptive Planning is an enterprise planning platform for budgets, forecasts, scenarios, workforce plans, reporting, analytics, and financial consolidation. Finance and operations teams use multidimensional models, governed workflows, integrations, and collaborative planning to align plans with actual results.
agentUseSummary: Workday Adaptive Planning cannot yet be connected through Relay. Workday advertises broad REST import, export, metadata, transaction, user, role, version, currency, instance, and publish surfaces, but the safe authority is defined by each paid customer's instance, model, roles, sheets, dimensions, versions, and integration configuration. Relay has no generic delegated OAuth contract or field-minimized product decision that permits an agent to access or change those financial and workforce plans.

blocked.label: Connect Adaptive Planning
blocked.description: No generic Relay-owned delegated application contract is documented; a customer instance, licensed integration rights, and tenant-defined service authority are required.

blocked.label: Read plans and actuals
blocked.description: Budgets, plans, forecasts, actuals, transactions, reports, sheets, accounts, dimensions, levels, versions, currencies, instances, users, roles, workforce data, and consolidation data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Import or change planning data
blocked.description: Importing or erasing actuals, transactions and model data; changing accounts, dimensions, levels, users, roles, sheets, attributes, versions, currencies or instances; and other model mutations are blocked.

blocked.label: Publish plans or run workflows
blocked.description: Publishing, unpublishing, approving, rejecting, submitting, locking, recalculating, forecasting, consolidating, exporting, scheduling, and committing scenario decisions are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw Adaptive Planning interfaces
blocked.description: Arbitrary REST calls, private APIs, custom scripts, browser automation, session cookies, credential capture, raw exports, bulk extraction, and cross-instance fallback are blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: Workday documents Adaptive Planning as a paid, customer-configured enterprise platform with a broad REST API and integration framework. Its advertised API surface covers imports of standard, cube and model account data, transactions and erased actuals; exports of plan data; metadata for dimensions, levels, users, accounts, sheets, attributes, time, versions, currencies, instances and roles; and publish state. The authoritative schema, instance URL, authentication, permissions, model semantics, roles, licensed features and safe fields depend on the customer's environment and protected Workday resources. A generic all-model agent wrapper would expose unbounded financial, workforce and scenario authority, while Relay cannot invent a universally safe subset without an exact customer use case.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, finance, workforce-data, legal, privacy, security, and customer owners must choose one bounded planning outcome and representative customer instance. Freeze the service identity, instance and model, exact accounts, sheets, dimensions, levels, versions, scenarios, fields, currencies, time ranges, workflow stages, read and write operations, approval owners, retention, export, audit, recalculation, rollback, and deletion rules. A tenant administrator must then provide current official API and authentication documentation and create least-privilege integration authority. Only after that may Relay implement typed bounded wrappers, safe-mode approvals for every mutation and financial decision, exact-instance binding, idempotency, audits, redaction, and post-disable denial.

evidence.supports: Workday describes public standards-based REST APIs spanning data and metadata import, plan export, transactions, users, roles, models, versions, currencies, instances, and publish state.
Workday presents automated, custom scripted, and manual Adaptive Planning integration models and a customer-configured framework for imports, exports, transformations, and scheduling.
Adaptive Planning is contract-priced and packages production, non-production and secondary instances, integrations, SSO, planning models, audit trails, and add-on capabilities.
Workday documents Adaptive Planning application sessions, authentication-related instance data, integration iframe requests, and CSRF protections, which are not a third-party API credential contract.
Workday's privacy materials distinguish enterprise customer-controlled data and Workday's platform responsibilities.
